bias.en: Bullish · pulled back from the record zone
bias.zh: 偏多 · 自纪录区域回落

read.en: Microsoft fell 1.8% on Oct 14 to $533.69 after reaching $545.74. It is just under its 5-day average ($535.2) and above the 10-day ($529.1), 30-day ($510.0), 100-day ($453.1) and 200-day ($434.8), all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 1 with a slowly narrowing histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Aug 28 ($526.2), and RSI is 62.
read.zh: 微软 10月14日触及 $545.74 后回落，下跌 1.8%，收于 $533.69。股价略低于 5 日均线（$535.2），并在均上行的 10 日（$529.1）、30 日（$510.0）、100 日（$453.1）和 200 日均线（$434.8）上方。MACD 自 10月1日起位于信号线上方，柱状图缓慢收窄，抛物线 SAR 自 8月28日起看多（$526.2），RSI 为 62。

read.en: The close slipped back below $537 (Oct 9 high), which returns to resistance, ahead of $551 (Oct 13 high) and the $553–555 record zone from October 2025. Support is $529 (10-day average; day's low $532.5), then $526 (SAR) and $510 (30-day average). A close below $526 would flip the SAR bearish; a close above $555 would be a new record.
read.zh: 收盘跌回 $537（10月9日高点）下方，该位置重新成为阻力，其上为 $551（10月13日高点）和 2025年10月的 $553–555 纪录区域。支撑为 $529（10 日均线；当日低点 $532.5），其次 $526（SAR）和 $510（30 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $526，SAR 将转为看空；收盘站上 $555 则创纪录新高。
